children: fell 4.23% in premarket after Bloomberg reported that it sent a force majeure notice to the developer of Project Jupiter, a massive data center being built in New Mexico, citing people familiar with the situation. The developer is a unit of Blue Owl Capital
, and the project has already run into local opposition and regulatory setbacks.

Oracle isn't trying to walk away as the site's main tenant, the people said. Instead, it's aiming to put off payments if the project is derailed and fails to come online in 2028 as planned, protecting itself from potential cost increases on the build. Companies typically invoke force majeure to free themselves from contractual obligations when problems arise beyond their control. The notice suggests Oracle sees a real risk the timeline slips, and it could shift part of that risk onto Blue Owl.

title: Oracle Stock Falls on Force Majeure Notice for Data Center
